name: countz-accounting
description: Accounting analyses using Countz Accounting platform: tie out ledgers, sub-ledgers and schedules; reconcile cash to bank and payables to supplier statements; prove out cash ahead of an audit; build a quality-of-earnings EBITDA bridge; test ASC 606 revenue recognition and ASC 842 lease accounting; trace revenue leakage from invoice to cash and many more. You get a workbook and a report deck with every figure traceable to its source file.
